summary: The appellant, a retired Associate Professor, sought interest on delayed payment of retirement benefits due to administrative delays. The High Court acknowledged entitlement to interest but deferred action pending government enquiry. The Supreme Court held that the delay was not attributable to the appellant, upheld his right to interest, and directed the College/Management to pay interest from date of retirement until actual payment, subject to final government decision on liability. The payment was ordered within six weeks, with the right of recovery from the ultimately liable party.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned orders quashed; College/Management directed to pay interest on delayed retirement benefits within six weeks, subject to final government decision on liability.
